message: Last summer, a surprise blackout hit while I was in the middle of a popcorn binge. I fumbled around for my flashlight, only to find it was dead—classic me! Meanwhile, my phone was starting to dim, and I was left in the dark, munching on stale popcorn like a raccoon. Lesson learned: I now keep a power bank charged and a couple of lanterns handy. So, what's your go-to plan when the lights go out?
